abstract_summary: The purpose of this study was to develop and validate lesion identification in oncologic nuclear imaging (LION), an open-source PET-only tumor segmentation pipeline for [18F]FDG and prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)–targeted PET/CT, and to investigate how training data characteristics influence segmentation...
